entries.title: Date and time input accepts only ISO 8601: Postgres's other formats and its special values (infinity, epoch, today) are errors
Doubles turn into text in exponent form from 1e6; Postgres writes them in full up to 1e15
ROUND of a double, and casts from a double to an integer, round half away from zero; Postgres rounds half to even
VARIANCE and STDDEV of integers and NUMERIC return DOUBLE PRECISION; Postgres returns NUMERIC
